job.name: t1.sft.build
job.what: Build the Track 1 SFT dataset: execution (twin-labelled, seeds < 900000), interface and safety examples; zero overlap with the frozen eval items
job.role: bb26-SageMakerExecution (existing; never created by this job)
job.prerequisite: the organisers' ran_rl-1.2.9-py3-none-any.whl at s3://{{bucket}}/sdk/1.2.9/ (team bucket only, never git; today only sdk/1.2.7/ exists there)
reads: the code bundle's t1/evals/items/ (frozen eval items, f1d3deb)

expected.wall_min: about 15-50: about 2 s of twin time per execution state (40 candidates x 2 trial steps), 16 workers, keep rate unknown until run; --time-budget-s caps labelling at 50 min

declared.model_id: none (dataset build: labels from the twin, the SDK safety filter and templates)
declared.grader: t1/sft/overlap.py:check_disjoint (t1-sft-overlap-v1: item hash, answer-free input hash, exact prompt hash and (scenario, seed, step) of every written example against all 1,220 frozen eval items, dev and test; plus within-set duplicates)

config.labeler: t1.evals.gen_execution:reference (best of the eval's 40 single-cell candidates by counterfactual gain; clipped candidates skipped)

decoding.test_set_is: sha256 of t1/evals/items/MANIFEST.json at f1d3deb, which pins the sha256 of all five frozen item files

job.split: sha256(t1-sft-split-v1, unit, key); execution key = twin seed

decoding.dedupe: an example is dropped if any hash matches an eval item, or if its answer-free hash repeats inside the set; generated, dropped and kept counts go in manifest.json
